message.content: In the conversation, the suggestion of adding a seating area was made, which later evolved into discussing the possibility of including benches or chairs. Specifically, Turalyon proposed, "We could do a circle or semi-circle layout, so people can face each other and enjoy the view!" This indicates that the idea of placing tables near the benches was part of the broader discussion about the seating area. However, there isn't a direct mention of proposing tables specifically near the benches, but rather a suggestion to have a seating area with a potential circular or semi-circular layout that includes benches.
